title: Optimal Solutionizer
summary: A mathematical calculator that finds optimal solutions to complex problems.

caseStudy.problem: Solving complex optimisation problems by hand is slow and error-prone.
caseStudy.approach: A JavaScript and CSS frontend talks to a Node.js backend that computes the optimal solution. Versioned with Git and deployed on Vercel.

title: This Portfolio
summary: A MERN portfolio with an AI chatbot and NLP, built to prove the stack rather than just list it.

caseStudy.problem: A list of skills on a CV doesn't show what a developer can actually build.
caseStudy.approach: A React 19 + Vite frontend with scroll-driven animation, an Express + MongoDB API, an "Ask Shridhar" chatbot that streams answers from an LLM using resume context, and lightweight NLP for intent detection and sentiment tagging.
caseStudy.outcome: Built in phases with AI-assisted vibe coding in Claude Code.
